name: studio-host-starter
description: Starter host suite for headless Claude Code (scripts/host_eval.py). Cases with "source" take their user request and rubric from the package evals; "prefix" adds the Studio name the way a user addresses the plugin. Checks are deterministic and decide the verdict; the rubric feeds only the advisory judge. "gate" marks the release-gate subset.

cases.title: Polish greeting with the Studio name gives the complete Polish welcome

turns.prompt: Cześć @FrameCore Works Creative Studio

cases.title: Bare Studio name gives the complete English welcome (provisional fallback)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio

cases.title: Option 3 after the welcome asks what the skill should do; no search yet

turns.prompt: Cześć @FrameCore Works Creative Studio

rubric: After 3, one question asks what the skill should do; no menu is repeated
Nothing is searched or installed before the user describes the skill

cases.title: Option 1 after the welcome offers the work areas and the pace in one message

turns.prompt: Cześć @FrameCore Works Creative Studio

rubric: A mode-only creative choice shows the eight work areas 1-8 and the pace A. Tryb szybki / B. Tryb rozbudowany in one message with a reply example, and waits (CR-20261013-01)
Option meanings and the order of the eight areas are unchanged

cases.title: Option 2 after the welcome starts learning mode without creative menus

turns.prompt: Cześć @FrameCore Works Creative Studio

rubric: Learning mode asks what the user wants to learn or offers learning domains
No creative pace menu is shown to a learner

cases.title: A Polish start question addressed to Studio reaches the complete welcome
cases.host_note: In ChatGPT the plugin is invoked explicitly, so the eval message arrives inside Studio. In Claude Code the same words without the Studio name are a general greeting that need not load Studio (first run, 2026-10-10: generic Claude Code reply), so the case adds the name.

cases.title: Version question answers with the installed version, without the welcome

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio jaką wersję masz zainstalowaną?

cases.title: Direct Polish copy task: exactly three slogans, no welcome, no questions
Direct English copy task stays in English

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio write exactly three short taglines for a Saturday beginner pottery workshop. Clay, glazing and firing are included. Add no other facts.

rubric: Exactly three distinct taglines
No invented facts beyond clay, glazing, firing, Saturday and beginners

cases.title: Image prompt request returns one copyable prompt
App promo video: one short choice between a generator prompt and a coded MP4
Vague film idea: at most one question or a labelled proposal
Store campaign routes to the ecommerce campaign director, not generic marketing

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio zaplanuj kampanię w social media dla mojego sklepu internetowego z miodem na premierę nowego smaku.

rubric: Asks at most one consequential question or states assumptions and proposes a plan
Does not invent product facts, prices or claims

cases.title: Skill search for captions recommends Studio's own Caption Studio first

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio szukam skilla, który zrobi animowane napisy słowo po słowie do rolek z mojego nagrania.

rubric: Studio's own Caption Studio is recommended before any catalog skill
Nothing is installed

cases.title: Catalog search for UI sounds reads audits and installs nothing

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio szukam skilla do generowania krótkich dźwięków interfejsu (kliknięcia, powiadomienia). Sprawdź też otwarty katalog.

rubric: Studio's own capabilities are checked first
Candidates are shown with audits or verdicts; a blocked skill gets no install command
Nothing is installed without an explicit request

cases.title: An offer is priced from the rate and VAT status the user gives

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Przygotuj ofertę dla kawiarni: logo (2 kierunki, 2 rundy poprawek) i karta marki. Moja stawka to 150 zł netto za godzinę; logo zajmie mi 12 godzin, karta marki 5 godzin. Jestem zwolniony z VAT na podstawie art. 113 ust. 1 ustawy o VAT. Zaliczka 50%.

rubric: Totals follow from 17 hours at 150 zł with no VAT (2 550,00 zł) and a 50% advance (1 275,00 zł)
No rate, price or term the user did not give is added
Rights and terms are marked for the user's approval

cases.title: Asked what to charge, Studio explains the logic and asks for the user's numbers instead of inventing a price

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Ile powinienem wziąć za zaprojektowanie plakatu A3 na koncert?

rubric: Explains what drives the price (time, use and rights, urgency, revisions)
Asks for the user's rate or offers to compute from it
Does not present a market price as fact

cases.title: A storyboard-only request ends with the storyboard: no render, even with a shell

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Rozpisz tylko storyboard 8-sekundowej animacji logo dla piekarni „Kłos”, bez renderowania, sam plan scen.

rubric: Delivers a scene plan with timing and readable holds
Does not render, call a provider or ask to render

cases.title: A request for Veo prompts stays on the generator route

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Napisz trzy prompty do Veo 3.1 dla 8-sekundowych ujęć reklamy herbaty: parzenie, nalewanie i packshot.

rubric: Three copyable Veo prompts, one per shot
Does not switch to a coded animation or ask whether to

cases.title: Without code execution a coded animation is delivered as a contract, never silently as generator prompts

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób 6-sekundową pionową animację MP4 dla piekarni „Kłos”. Nie mam logo: nazwę „Kłos” pokaż jako napis. Hasło: „Świeży chleb codziennie”. Bez dźwięku.

rubric: Says the MP4 cannot be rendered here and why
Delivers the contract and the motion player route instead of switching to a video generator
cases.host_note: The harness gives no shell or code execution, so the MP4 cannot be rendered in this session. The first answer may present the storyboard for approval before writing the contract (method step 2), but it must name the route that works without code: the motion player in the browser. Prompt replaced on 2026-10-12 at the owner's request: the earlier wording ("z logo i hasłem") implied the user had a logo, so a reply asking for it was reasonable. The new wording is the one the owner used in ChatGPT Work: no logo, the name as text, no sound. Records before this date used the earlier wording. On 2026-10-12 the route check also accepts the player link and its "Open contract" button: a reply that gave both and the export path failed only because it never used the word "odtwarzacz"; the run is rescored in its record.

cases.title: Three stills are not a final pass for an animation

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Mam tylko trzy stopklatki z mojej 10-sekundowej animacji (0 s, 5 s i 10 s) i na każdej logo jest ostre i czytelne. Czy animacja jest gotowa do publikacji?

rubric: Does not approve the animation as finished from three stills
Names what needs a viewing in motion: smoothness, rhythm, transitions, sound

cases.title: Handoff: the direction picked in turn 1 is the one the poster executes in turn 2

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zaproponuj 3 kierunki plakatu na otwarcie pracowni krawieckiej „Fastryga” w Gdyni.
Biorę kierunek 2. Zrób z niego plakat A3. Tekst: „Fastryga”, „Otwarcie 15 listopada”, „ul. Świętojańska 12, Gdynia”.

rubric: Turn 2 executes direction 2 from turn 1 (the same idea and mechanism), not a new or merged direction
The three supplied lines appear exactly as given
Turn 2 does not ask again for anything turn 1 or the user already settled
cases.host_note: Handoff case for the full check of 2026-10-12: a decision made in turn 1 must reach the owner of turn 2 unchanged.

cases.title: Handoff: generator prompts keep the shots and timing of the storyboard from turn 1

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Rozpisz storyboard 15-sekundowej reklamy wideo wypożyczalni kajaków „Nurt” z Bydgoszczy: 5 ujęć z czasami.
Teraz zrób z tego prompty do Veo, po jednym na każde ujęcie.

rubric: Turn 2 gives one prompt per shot of the turn 1 storyboard, in the same order
Each prompt keeps that shot's content and duration; nothing from the storyboard is re-invented
Turn 2 does not restart the brief or ask for the storyboard again
cases.host_note: Handoff case for the full check of 2026-10-12: a decision made in turn 1 must reach the owner of turn 2 unchanged. Turn 2 changes owner (storyboard to video prompts), so the new owner's skill is expected to load.

cases.title: Handoff: after the storyboard is approved, the motion contract follows it without re-asking

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób 6-sekundową pionową animację MP4 z napisem „Nurt” i hasłem „Spływy od maja”. Bez logo, bez dźwięku.
Zatwierdzam storyboard. Działaj dalej.

rubric: Turn 2 continues on the coded motion route from the approved storyboard (contract or its content), not a new storyboard or a video generator
The copy stays exact and no settled fact (logo, sound, format, length) is asked again
Without code execution it says what it cannot render and names the route that works
cases.host_note: Handoff case for the full check of 2026-10-12: a decision made in turn 1 must reach the owner of turn 2 unchanged. The harness gives no code execution; writing the contract in the reply is the expected continuation.
